Firmware sources

firmforge starts with a few well-known publishers so it is useful immediately. Add your own by pasting a GitHub repository or a link to a published manifest.json.

firmforge links to each publisher's own downloads rather than rehosting their binaries. Every source here can be removed, and removals are remembered.
